To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the ASTER data allow us to map 1000 individual glaciers on southern Baffi Island, Canada, with an overall accuracy of 95% and a positional accuracy of 20m, and that the derived glacier extents show an overall increase of 2% in the 25-year period between 1975 and the year 2000.

(1) glacier mapping using MSS data is possible but requires careful visual inspection and manual correction, (2) ASTER data are very useful for mapping glaciers in the Arctic and (3) the new glacier inventory reveals that the glaciers on southern Baff in Island have retreated significantly over the past decades.

(a) the semi-automatic glacier-mapping approach developed for MSS data can be successfully applied to ASTER data; (b) the glacier area and volume estimates derived from ASTER DEM differ from those derived from SRTM DEM, but are more reliable due to higher spatial resolution of the ASTER DEM; and (c) the glacier inventory for southern Baffin lsland shows a total area of 1 800 km2 and a total length of 3 000 km.

the semi-automated mapping approach is applicable for the extraction of glacier outlines and DEMs from MSS data, and that the resulting glacier inventory is of sufficient quality to allow for a quantitative assessment of glacier change.
